gates.evidence: Surface s19 is the Settings page, which is SFW and age-appropriate.
Reward is in-app feature access, with no cash rewards, crypto, or incentivized clicks/installs.
Offer uses positive gain framing ('unlock 30 minutes') with standard CTA and decline buttons.
User explicitly opts in by tapping the sample chip and the 'Play to try' button.
The required action ('15-second game') and reward are clearly stated before the ad starts.
Decline option ('No thanks') is present and returns the user to Settings without penalty.
Placed on the Settings screen (s19), completely away from active AI streaming responses.
Eligibility explicitly excludes existing subscribers ('never subscribers').

scores.evidence: The proposal targets the upgrade upsell on Settings (s19), but has a severe internal contradiction: the text and storyboard state '30 minutes of Upgrade to Luzia+', while the reward object specifies '7 days of Luzia+ Subscription'.
Placed natively on the Settings screen (s19) next to the upgrade upsell with a clean chip and standard modal flow.
Granting '7 days of Luzia+ Subscription' (as specified in reward.what) for watching a 15-second ad twice a day completely cannibalizes paid subscriptions by giving 14 days of free access per week.
While COGS is listed as none, trading a full 7-day subscription entitlement for a single ad view worth ~$0.012 severely misaligns unit economics.
Settings is reached frequently during app exploration (m12), but it is not part of the core chat loop.
Uses standard SIM-RWD unit, button entry, and a clean patch on s19.
Correctly references screen s19, element e10, resource r1, and wall w1 from the digest.
Capped at 2 per day with a 60-minute cooldown.
Defines primary metric, guardrails (-3% plan conversion non-inferiority), and a 10% user-level holdout for 4 weeks.

requiredChanges: Align the reward specification in reward.what and reward.duration to strictly match the 30-minute time-box stated in the text (30 minutes of Luzia+ features) rather than 7 full days.
Ensure complete consistency between offer copy, storyboard, and reward schema fields to prevent severe subscription cannibalization.
parsed.topConcern: The proposal contains a dangerous contradiction where the reward object grants '7 days of Luzia+ Subscription', which would completely destroy subscription revenue by allowing users to obtain unlimited free weeks of premium access via ad views.
